statement: A scorer refused credit when a workflow named always(), failure() or cancelled(), yet credited if: success() || true, which runs after a failed check exactly as always() does. A refusal list of spellings is evaded by any other spelling with the same platform effect. Rules: admit only the one safe shape (a plain success() ANDed with no status term), and require every occurrence in the file to be accounted for in a position the reader parsed whole.
